<p>Today we&#x27;re introducing <strong>Build Mode</strong>, a new way to create with <a href="https://grok.com/?referrer=website">Grok</a>. Tell Grok an idea, and it builds a working version live in your chat, on the web or your phone. When it&#x27;s ready, publish it to a link anyone can open. Build Mode is available today in Early Beta for <strong>SuperGrok Heavy</strong> subscribers on the web, iOS, and Android.</p>
<h2 id="describe-what-you-want"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#describe-what-you-want">Describe what you want</a></h2>
<p>Grok writes the code and builds a working preview inside the conversation. From there it keeps building with you: change the layout, add a feature, restyle anything.</p>
<p>There&#x27;s nothing to install and nothing to configure, and you never have to touch the code unless you want to.</p>
<h2 id="made-with-build-mode"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#made-with-build-mode">Made with Build Mode</a></h2>
<p>Every example below was created by Build Mode from the message shown above it.</p>

<h2 id="what-people-are-building"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#what-people-are-building">What people are building</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Websites.</strong> Landing pages, portfolios, and business sites.</li>
<li><strong>Apps.</strong> Working tools with real state and logic: planners, trackers, calculators, simulations, and internal utilities.</li>
<li><strong>Games.</strong> Arcade racers, puzzles, and interactive 3D worlds.</li>
<li><strong>Interactive dashboards.</strong> Leverage connectors so Grok can pull in the data that matters to your business and turn it into live charts and filterable views you can explore and share immediately.</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="share-it-with-a-link"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#share-it-with-a-link">Share it with a link</a></h2>
<p>Publish to a grok.me link or a custom domain you own, then share it with your team or anyone else who needs it.</p>
<h2 id="available-today-in-early-beta"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#available-today-in-early-beta">Available today in Early Beta</a></h2>
<p>During the Early Beta, Build Mode is available to <strong>SuperGrok Heavy</strong> subscribers. To try it, open <a href="https://grok.com/?referrer=website">grok.com</a> or the Grok app on iOS and Android and choose <strong>Build</strong> from the mode switcher. You can also learn more on the <a href="/grok/build-mode">Build Mode page</a>.</p>
